_comment: Append policy. tools/append and tools/verify BOTH read `threshold` from this file, so the write rule and the read rule cannot drift apart. WARNING: this file is not signed and is not in the ledger -- whoever can write it decides what verifies. At threshold 0 any well-formed chain verifies regardless of signatures; the hash chain still makes modification of an existing event detectable, but authorization is gone. See CLAUDE.md 2.3.
